Thermaltake Toughpower GX1 RGB 600W
Built to deliver 80 PLUS Gold efficiency,
Toughpower GX1 RGB features
capacities ranging from 500W to 700W. 10 RGB LEDs come preinstalled on the
Hydraulic Bearing fan to provide
multiple vivid lighting mode/color options, LED Off, and a built-in memory
function.
Coming with premium components, Japanese 105°C/221°F main capacitor, its near
silent operation, trouble
free installation and reliable performance have made itself satisfy the market
where value-oriented users
are looking for a power supply with advanced features and aesthetic appeal.
*The image is for reference only.
One Button to Your Desired Color
Adding personal appeal to your build has never
been easier. By just
pressing one RGB lighting button! There is also a built-in memory function to
save the applied color and
ensure the same color selection every time you turn on your PC.
10 RGB LEDs Preinstalled
The 10 RGB LEDs come preinstalled on the
120mm fan. Capable of
displaying 7 colors(Red, Green, Blue, Yellow, Purple, Light Blue, and White), 3
illumination modes
including Pulse, Full-lighted and 256-color RGB Cycle, and an LED Off mode.
* All images are for reference only; actual specification and lighting effects
are based on the real
product.
120mm RGB Hydraulic Bearing Fan
Featuring an 120mm RGB Hydraulic Bearing fan
with intelligent RPM control
to guarantee superior cooling performance and silent operation.
Low Ripple Noise
The maximum ripple/noise is lower than 60mV on
the +12V rail, and lower
than 40mV on the +5V &+3.3V rails to ensure an excellent power supply stability.
Low ripple noise will keep
your performance-critical components, such as high-end graphics cards, to
operate reliably for longer.
﹤ ±3% Strict Voltage Regulation
The voltage regulation of the PSU is set to no
more than ±3% for major
rails to meet the highest performance. The strict voltage regulation is better
than Intel’s standard ±5%
for major rails and ±10% for -12V.
High Quality Japanese 105°C/221°F Main Capacitor
Comes with high quality 105 °C (221 ° F)
Japanese main capacitor to
greatly improve the durability and offer the highest stability and reliability.
High Amperage Single +12V Rail & DC to DC Design
Powerful single +12V rail and DC to DC design
ensure a stable and reliable
supply to other PC components.
Multiple Connectors
All sleeved cables make cable installation an
easy task while powering
the system at an advantageous voltage.
80 PLUS Gold Certified and Intel C6/C7 States
Ready
Toughpower GX1 RGB saves energy through its
high energy efficiency up to
90% and is certified to 80 PLUS® Gold. The series has been optimized to work
with all generations of
Intel’s processors to achieve maximum energy saving.
RGB Lighting Gives Best Aesthetics for All
Chassis
Toughpower GX1 RGB Series is the best idea for
users to go with when they
are looking for an RGB PSU that permits remarkable functionality and aesthetics
in all cases.
